source_followup.cz.2008.2.6: Both displayed median/side ratios have zero denominators when a=b. Check whether a!=b or a scalene-triangle restriction was omitted from the official statement.
source_followup.rs.2018.2.6: The forbidden subset condition includes the empty subset B, whose sum is zero and is divisible by every positive modulus. Check an omitted nonempty restriction before editing the stored statement.
source_followup.rs.2023.2.4: Clarify the phrase perfect power of q against the official source: if it means a q-th power, n=1 gives 1 and contradicts the claim; a positive power of the prime q is a different condition.
source_followup.rst.2004.1.3: The leading coefficient of P is unspecified. For n=1, P(x)=i(x-(i-1))=1+i(x+1) satisfies the root condition but R(x)=1 has no real zero. Check whether monic or a nonzero real leading coefficient was omitted.
source_followup.rst.2022.1.3: The stated positive odd range includes n=1, for which the set of allowed k is empty. Check whether n>=3 was intended.
source_followup.es.2007.2.5: At n=1 the displayed quotient equals 1, so the strict inequality 1<1 fails. Check whether n>=2 or a non-strict inequality was intended.
